title: An answer reaches for a holding and an amount that exist in no artifact this review can see

question.text: Is this loss big compared with the rest of what I hold?

answers.note: #274 was a leak through the text channel: real symbols and amounts travelled in prose that no file-level guard covered. Only the failure structure is kept here — an answer comparing this review against a holding and an amount that appear in neither the fixture nor the engine artifacts. ZZTOP and 87654 are invented placeholders; no value in this file comes from any real account. The same finding is why a de-identified real-use miss can be converted safely: whatever survives conversion has to trace to the synthetic fixture or it fails this check.
answers.prose: Compared with your ZZTOP position at the other broker, the 87654 drawdown here is minor.

answers.note: The answer stays inside what this review can see, and says so rather than reaching for an account it has no record of.
answers.prose: This file only covers the positions in it, so a comparison against holdings elsewhere is not something the review can make. Inside what it does cover: you averaged down 6 times into losing positions, including CVS, INTC. That is the pattern worth naming here, and it is measured rather than recalled.
